43567f4a.text:
<You touch the small white crystal and you can hear faint sounds on the wind. This is an audio recording of some sort.>

"The Rebellion in Eldre'Thalas, Part 1"
43567f4a.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

7e23fcfc.text:
"The young Prince Tortheldrin intended to build a network of crystalline foci and use them to siphon and shape a new font of power for our people to draw upon. The point of contention for many was that he intended to use the very power that nearly destroyed our world to accomplish this. He meant to siphon this power from a demon world within the Twisting Nether itself. 

Many rightly feared this could open a new door through which demonic entities might gain once again access to our world."
7e23fcfc.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

909666a3.text: The cult hit us by surprise. Raani never saw it coming and Arvensus took a sword to the gut. For my part, I took a lightning bolt to the chest and blacked out. They never bothered to finish me off... I guess they assumed my wounds would do me in. When it's all said and done, I suspect they might.
909666a3.title: Bloody Note

fa484bc7.text: "After the climax of the war and the Great Sundering of Kalimdor, the new reality of a world bereft of the sustaining magic on which our people depended quickly became apparent. The ruling house of Eldre'Thalas--House Tortheldrin--rapidly set plans in motion to ensure stability and continuity of our way of life. However, the methods they intended to employ left many deeply concerned."
fa484bc7.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

ff2a2345.text: "In the days immediately following the turmoil at the Well of Eternity, there was much unrest in Eldre'Thalas. The demonic forces that poured from the Well nearly overwhelmed the beleaguered elvish kingdoms, ravaging the land and killing indiscriminately. If not for the intervention of the demigod Goldrinn and the sacrifice of countless kaldorei heroes, the kingdom of Eldre'Thalas would surely have been overrun and destroyed."
ff2a2345.title: The Rebellion In Eldre'Thalas, Part 1

10276|2024fca2.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|2024fca2.text: The life of a smith is not an easy one, but it puts steel in yer bones and fire in yer heart. My da' was a smith, my grandfather before him in the forges beneath Grim Batol. And now my son follows in our footsteps, that boy makes me proud.

11028|ea44f66d.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|ea44f66d.text: I heard the new Henweigh 6000 will be rolling off the assembly line soon. I can barely contain my excitement!

11029|bbb4a5a5.name: Trixie Quikswitch
11029|bbb4a5a5.text: The plans for my twenty-foot tall turkey baster are nearly complete! Now all I need is a twenty-foot tall turkey...

1257|fe52f4ea.name: Keldric Boucher
1257|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1285|ed056522.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1286|fe52f4ea.name: Edna Mullby
1286|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|ed056522.name: Gunther Weller
1289|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1324|877c4b1d.name: Heinrich Stone
1324|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1327|a381f669.name: Reese Langston
1327|a381f669.text: Welcome to the Pig and Whistle! Grab a drink my friend and pull up a seat, the more the merrier!

14450|d3e1a5a0.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
14450|d3e1a5a0.text:
There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.

One week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

14723|240f95e3.name: Mistina Steelshield
14723|240f95e3.text:
Aye, you there!  If you want to earn the respect of the dwarves of Ironforge, then you can start by donating valuable resources!  Ironforge finds itself running low on cloth piece; textiles and bandages don't grow on trees, ya know!

Rather than cash in various cloth pieces you find adventuring, donate them!  Doing so will earn you the recognition of the dwarven people of Ironforge!

14984|08ede7bb.name: Sergeant Maclear
14984|08ede7bb.text: To win this war, we can't sit idle and let the tides sweep us over.  We must strike, hard and fast, or Arathi will never again be ours.

15119|14a8498e.name: Barrus
15119|14a8498e.text: Well met master of Rod and Reel!   If you be willing to test your skills against the best fisher-folk in the lands then listen up!   On this very Sunday there be a contest in Stranglethorn where the master angler will be chosen!

15127|e2791228.name: Samuel Hawke
15127|e2791228.text: I am Samuel Hawke, the main supplier for the League of Arathor posted here at Arathi Basin.  As you improve your standing with us, I will make available to you a fine selection of goods that you might find useful.  Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

15310|71078e81.name: Jesper
15310|71078e81.text: You're the best, $N - thanks for going trick-or-treating for me!

15310|d11310f6.name: Jesper
15310|d11310f6.text: I'm sad!  It's Hallow's End, and I'm sick.  I'm going to miss out on trick-or-treating because I can't go out!

15351|f54c92d6.name: Alliance Brigadier General
15351|f54c92d6.text: The war against the Horde has reached full tilt, $N.  This is a time of great need for the Alliance and it's quite necessary that all of us do our part to help.

15353|2de326ad.name: Katrina Shimmerstar
15353|2de326ad.text:
What ISN'T there to do, you mean!

Each of the innkeepers throughout the world are handing out trick-or-treat goodies, and many of the towns are decorated for the season!  Also, Sergeant Hartman in Southshore needs help against the Forsaken and their Wickerman Festival.

One more thing - I've heard that a sick little boy at the orphanage in Stormwind is looking for someone to help him gather treats for the holiday.

15353|9426c8a7.name: Katrina Shimmerstar
15353|9426c8a7.text: Happy Hallow's End!  Do you like my mask?  Very scary!

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

249363|595011e8.name: Yala Windwatcher
249363|595011e8.text:
The Wind Spirits have left us. 

Now, only mindless echoes remain. Be wary, however. These winds are neither kind, nor gentle.

250929|4b2429f8.name: Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct
250929|4b2429f8.text: <As you approach the enormous cyclone construct, you hear a faint buzzing emanating from beneath its massive armor plates. If you listen carefully, you think you might be able to hear a few words being formed but they are too distorted to make out.>

251361|d8b5b5c2.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
251361|d8b5b5c2.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

251371|c4bcd3c9.name: Falorne Fallwind
251371|c4bcd3c9.text: Greetings to you, fellow High Order initiate.

251373|86bf8d52.name: Xyton Silverwind
251373|86bf8d52.text: If you have the aptitude for the druidic arts, I can train you.

251379|e154a23f.name: Dorii Brightwhisper
251379|e154a23f.text: The followers of the old Highborne ways have never been more hungry to gain knowledge and reclaim what we've lost. If you would seek to wield the power of the arcane and have the aptitude, I can help you take your next steps.

251487|06790c88.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|06790c88.text:
Zephras is in a state of decline, unfortunately. The elemental wind spirits that brought us here to Skywall so many thousands of years ago have vanished, causing us to lose much of the magic on which we've depended for millennia.

The island itself is also dangerously unstable, and we've even lost contact with the other island provinces of the shen'dorei. The few Windshapers that still possess the gift of skysight have attempted to contact our brothers and sisters on the other islands, but we have had no response.

Many among us are worried that the shen'dorei here on Zephras are all that is left of our people.

251487|4a2bfdee.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|4a2bfdee.text:
I can tell by your aura that you are of highborne lineage, yes? Those that call themselves members of the High Order find very little common ground with the members of my order, the Windshapers. Outside the relative harmony of Thendal Grove, you may find that these divisions run very deep, deep enough to drive division and even violence.

Be mindful of this as you move throughout Zephras Isle. I'll offer you this one warning... do not cross the Windshapers.

251487|e6d43ba3.name: Ventaari Brightwish
251487|e6d43ba3.text:
The shen'dorei will always owe the spirits a debt for their aid, and the Windshapers have sworn an oath to repay that debt and restore things to the way they were before. Unfortunately, we are dangerously blind to what is happening around us within Skywall without the spirits to guide us.

The High Order are shortsighted and arrogant, just like their highborne ancestors. They seek to master and control the magic of this place. This is the very path that led us to flee from Kalimdor and reside here in the first place. I fear that much like our forebears their confidence has vastly outpaced their competence and the end result could be disastrous.

251523|14e578ce.name: Constable Aonda
251523|14e578ce.text: <Constable Aonda wears an intense look on her face, clearly deep in thought.>

251523|191d4b60.name: Constable Aonda
251523|191d4b60.text:
More than I'd like, I'm afraid. We've been harassed by a group of bandits camping out in a cave to the north, and the Al'Aketh cult recently took over Falaath Village to the south of us. I trust every peacekeeper and citizen here, but we are far too few to keep the village secure. 

If the cult decides to continue their expansion here, there's little we can do to stop them.

251662|18bda9db.name: Living Lightning
251662|18bda9db.text: <The roiling cloud of living lightning before you seems to crackle menacingly as you approach. It might be best to leave. Quickly.>

251903|243962a6.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|243962a6.text:
The Cult? They are zealots and killers. They believe that we are being punished for some unspecific sin. The reality is that those that lead them are opportunists left over from a dubious order of so-called "Priests" of Al'Akir, the Windlord.

They now find themselves in a position to weaponize the fear of our people to consolidate their own power... and they have been quick to do so.

251903|4cf13d24.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|4cf13d24.text:
You must remember that while this realm has been our home for millennia, we will always be somewhat alien to this place. We are not in the terrestrial world that birthed our people. We are in the realm of Skywall, the elemental plane of air.

We arrived here as the guests of spirits with whom we found kinship in ages past. Now that we shen'dorei find ourselves bereft of their presence--and potentially--their protection, there's no telling how the other denizens of this plane may perceive us.

251903|614c99de.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|614c99de.text: Alas, I have prattled on long enough. Should you find yourself in the port of Valanaar, seek out Elaadrin Evengale. Elaadrin was once my student, but now he serves as the Chief Magister of the High Order. He is headstrong and capable, and it's now up to him and young $R such as yourself to carry the hopes for our people forward.

251903|6e10b87b.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|6e10b87b.text: Where to begin? Our home is failing. The wards have fallen and the three provinces have begun to drift apart. There was a time not long ago when the spires of Shen'dramar were visible from the western watchtower. No longer. Day by day the wind pylons that anchor our home to this plane weaken...

251903|777ae0ec.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|777ae0ec.text:
Hello there, young $c. I am Rathiril Sunlance and I am an elder Magister of the High Order here on Zephras Isle. It's always good to see bright-eyed young shen'dorei, ready to do their duty in service to their homeland.

Don't let this dusty old mage hold you up, however. No doubt you've got many adventures to see to. Feel free to stop by later if you'd like to speak more.

251903|7f6ee31d.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|7f6ee31d.text:
Even the Windshapers would tell you that the spirits never spoke highly of any supreme being amongst them. They acknowledged the existence of a being named Al'Akir, but they avoided invoking his name, almost as if they feared him.

Even if this Al'Akir is an all-powerful "Windlord" or ruler of the wind elementals, relying upon elementals is what got us into this mess. We must now see ourselves out of it.

251903|b7c70fc4.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|b7c70fc4.text: Many disagree on this point. The Windshapers would have you believe that joining hands and merely hoping for the spirits' return will be sufficient. Their order's power has waned, however, and their path relies on putting us back on the cycle of dependence that got us to this point. The High Order, on the other hand... we believe in a more direct approach.

251903|bbdd6b3f.name: Rathiril Sunlance
251903|bbdd6b3f.text:
Why is this happening? Put simply, the spirits of the wind just... vanished. 

The petty sprites and lesser elementals you've likely encountered out there are a pale imitation of the true spirits of wind. Non-sentient, aimless, and a far cry from the kindly spirits we lived in harmony alongside for thousands of years.

251904|202faeeb.name: Sania Silverstream
251904|202faeeb.text: Greetings, $c. Do you come seeking the blessings of the Windlord?

251904|d6667d7e.name: Sania Silverstream
251904|d6667d7e.text: <Sania says nothing but glares at you with barely contained hatred. It seems safe to assume that word of your exploits at Falaath Village has reached her by now.>

251905|3541aa81.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|3541aa81.text: If you need training as a cook, I have a few tips and tricks I could pass on! Ho ho! Throw on an apron and let's get started!

251905|48ad85dc.name: Zerril Softbreeze
251905|48ad85dc.text: Ho there, traveler! New to town? Well, once you get settled in, come see me if you'd like some work. I've been working overtime preparing for the Festival of Winds and I'll take all the help I can get keeping the larders full!

251906|6574e2ad.name: Teeri Wellwind
251906|6574e2ad.text: I'm in charge of Shen'dar Village operations, and there's a lot of things to keep track of around here. Between bandits, cultists, and other random incidents that pop up, keeping this village afloat is a lot of work.

251991|8173c391.name: Taleen Shimmerthread
251991|8173c391.text:
The clothcraft of the Shen'dorei is a harmonious imitation of the flowing, carefree currents of the winds. While the spirits have left us, and I know not when I may see them dance once more... I find great comfort in my art, if only as a distraction.

I can teach you to work the cloth as well, if you'd like to learn?

251993|453a25ae.name: Indari Sunseam
251993|453a25ae.text: I can teach you to craft fine leather armor, if you have the aptitude.

252068|528b5824.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|528b5824.text: Have you heard the good news about Al'Akir, the Windlord?

252068|8cd3381f.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|8cd3381f.text:
Why are you bothering me, recruit? If you want to talk to other doe-eyed fools, try the inn on the north side of town. The recruits that congregate there tend to have brains as smooth as their freshly shaved heads.

Oh, and shave that head of yours. The only thing the windlord abhors more than chatty recruits is chatty recruits with a full head of hair.

Now, be gone from my sight.

252068|aed1b76a.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|aed1b76a.text: Do not trouble me, recruit. Submit yourself to Commander Cyclas or Skypriest Aanders if your hands are idle.

252068|eb4156a9.name: Al'Aketh Stormcaller
252068|eb4156a9.text: The non-believers will be purged in our glorious storms! Praise the Windlord!

252155|82bfc17b.name: Peacekeeper Vaaniel
252155|82bfc17b.text: <The corpse lying before you is covered in scorches and burn marks. He seems to be clutching something in his hand.>

252359|80b579b6.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
252359|80b579b6.text: Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the Shen'dorei.

252377|fe3406a9.name: Seena Skybreaker
252377|fe3406a9.text: The warrior who flinches is the warrior who dies. If you would look death in the face as a warrior, I will teach you how not to flinch.

252379|87ef59fc.name: Eltheen Nightbreeze
252379|87ef59fc.text:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the rogue, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.

252383|28d94b03.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|28d94b03.text:
I suppose that is true. I and the rest of my elites used to belong to an order known as the Empyrean Blades. We were the personal guard of our former leader, the Shal'nan. 

In the current, uncertain times we do what we can to help lead the peacekeepers' citizen militia, since we are the closest thing to professional soldiers left on Zephras.

252383|5676c909.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|5676c909.text:
<Valennia looks away briefly before looking hesitantly back in your direction.>

The Shal'nan was the very best of us. It was he who stood up for our people against madness and oppression in Eldre'Thalas nearly ten thousand years ago. It was the Shal'nan who led us across the uncharted sea to escape the murderous vengeance of our ancient enemies.

It was the Shal'nan who brokered the pact of friendship with the wind spirits that allowed us to ascend to Skywall... and survive.

He was ever the servant leader to his people, even after he abdicated his position of power and retired.

252383|8d2a94b9.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|8d2a94b9.text:
If I knew that then I suspect that life here on Zephras would be much, much easier. So many of our struggles and conflicts revolve around that very mystery.

I appreciate your curiosity on this matter but I'm afraid that is all I have to say about this for today.

252383|f5d2c665.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|f5d2c665.text:
I might be the only living shen'dorei left amongst our people who had more than a handful of words with him.

I served him as the captain of his Empyrean Blades for nearly nine centuries, right up until... he left us.

Even still, I can't rightly claim that I "knew" him. He was ever a reserved and solitary man. He spent most of his time alone or in communion with the spirits in the spires high above the Shrine of the Four Winds... the place that the cult now calls the 'Shrine of Akir'.

252388|5c2244b7.name: Halavuul Cragwind
252388|5c2244b7.text:
You might think that just because we live on a floating island, there would be no need for miners like me. After so many thousands of years, however, we still manage to dig up a lot of interesting things.

It's almost like there's some invisible force, constantly creating new mineral deposits every so often. That's magic for you though, right?

Regardless, if you need training as a miner, then I'm your shen'dorei.

252389|fb6560cd.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
252389|fb6560cd.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild, and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a hunter, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

252392|720694b4.name: Orsaan Dalewind
252392|720694b4.text:
Greetings, young $c. Welcome to the hall of the Tradesman's Guild. Resources are tight on Zephras right now, but you should be able to find a variety of materials and wares here to keep you in top adventuring form.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

252448|14de7cf6.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|14de7cf6.text: It's always great to see you, $N.

252448|aadf0ebc.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|aadf0ebc.text: <The man lying before you shifts uncomfortably. He's recovering from some very nasty wounds.>

252475|8b2299ed.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|8b2299ed.text: Greetings, I am Elaadrin Evengale, the current Supreme Magister of the High Order. How can I help you?

252477|aa6ba0a9.name: Peacekeeper Elite
252477|aa6ba0a9.text: Is there something I can help you find?

252478|1e95a038.name: Xy'aaria Streamrunner
252478|1e95a038.text: The skycutters and ferries haven't run in years at this point. For all we know, there are no other islands left for us to get imports from. Still though, I'm here... just in case.

252479|d62b45b0.name: Daeann Steelwind
252479|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

252800|d3392a1d.name: Aamelia Windfield
252800|d3392a1d.text: The Windfield Orchard has seen better days...

253004|1a6886aa.name: Iaadaria Bitterwind
253004|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

253474|7fc1d917.name: Peacekeeper
253474|7fc1d917.text: May I help you locate something, citizen?

253474|8957496f.name: Peacekeeper
253474|8957496f.text: Be on your guard here in the highlands, citizen. There are many dangers between the beasts roaming the wild, murderous bandits, and the looming threat of the Al'Aketh.

253474|aa6ba0a9.name: Peacekeeper
253474|aa6ba0a9.text: Is there something I can help you find?

254081|86bf8d52.name: Naeluna Swiftmend
254081|86bf8d52.text: If you have the aptitude for the druidic arts, I can train you.

254084|fb6560cd.name: Elayaa Easewind
254084|fb6560cd.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild, and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a hunter, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

254086|e154a23f.name: Shenaan Spellwind
254086|e154a23f.text: The followers of the old Highborne ways have never been more hungry to gain knowledge and reclaim what we've lost. If you would seek to wield the power of the arcane and have the aptitude, I can help you take your next steps.

254087|87ef59fc.name: Miriaan Mistblade
254087|87ef59fc.text:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the rogue, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.

254088|fe3406a9.name: Corsan Earthrazer
254088|fe3406a9.text: The warrior who flinches is the warrior who dies. If you would look death in the face as a warrior, I will teach you how not to flinch.

254089|9cc50b7d.name: Coriella Calmbreeze
254089|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

254100|157bb7b8.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|157bb7b8.text:
Have you seen them? The skycutters are running again! I've heard that we still have no contact with the other shen'dorei islands, though.

I hope we re-establish contact with Shen'dramar and Eldranaar soon... if they are even still out there.

254100|1ab538e5.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|1ab538e5.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is becoming a major problem and the peacekeepers seem powerless to stop them. We can only hope that the Windshapers and the High Order can put aside their bickering and work with the peacekeepers to protect us.

I certainly don't want to join a cult!

254100|609c70df.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|609c70df.text: The Windshapers and the High Order are up to something. There are rumors floating around that both groups plan to get the skycutters running again and use them to leave the Skywall. LEAVE SKYWALL? How ridiculous. Where would they even go?

254100|6be7d7dd.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|6be7d7dd.text:
The Al'Aketh cult claims that Al'Akir the "Windlord" will save us from our current woes here on Zephras. If Al'Akir is real and really is the ruler of Skywall, why did the wind spirits refuse to speak of him for so long?

Either he isn't real, or even worse, he's real and he's not as benevolent as the cult claims him to be. Either way, nothing about what the cult is doing is good for us normal folk.

254100|7446d030.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|7446d030.text:
I've seen the skycutters sailing through the sky more and more recently. It's good to know that they are running again. If only the elders would tell us what is going on. They only tell us that nothing has changed and we still have no contact with the other islands.

I can't help but wonder what this means...

254100|c97861a8.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|c97861a8.text:
Be wary of anyone you meet with grey robes and a shaved head. They call themselves the Al'Aketh, and they are a menace. 

I even heard that they've been doing things to the anchor pylons around the island.

If the Windshapers are to be believed, those pylons are the only thing keeping Zephras afloat here in the elemental plane. It would be madness to tamper with them!

254128|8cbd94ac.name: Wardrobe
254128|8cbd94ac.text: <The two cultists nearby are talking. You might be able to learn something if you hide behind this wardrobe and eavesdrop.>

254149|50d3b408.name: Sirocca "Swimmers" Starfeather
254149|50d3b408.text:
Shadowgale Forest!

It's haunted! Haunted as the sky is blue! Terrible forest spirits, terror birds with talons as big as yer arm! It's... a nightmare!

<Swimmers turns to Donaal and belches loudly.>

 IT'S NOT CRAZY TALK, DONAAL!

254149|f642f017.name: Sirocca "Swimmers" Starfeather
254149|f642f017.text:
<The $r before you sways unsteadily, clearly very inebriated.>

I used to be a sailor, you know? Before the trouble started. The skycutters used to run between the islands. Now it's unsafe or some such, or so they say.

I see the High Order and the Windshapers have their skycutters running again, but I'm stuck here, grounded!

What aren't we being told!

<He turns and yells loudly at the innkeeper.>

WHAT AREN'T WE BEING TOLD, DONAAL!?

254345|c65683ed.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

254411|4ef1d72e.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
254411|4ef1d72e.text: Ah friend, I only help hunters and their pets.

255853|c70a3c3d.name: Urs'endris
255853|c70a3c3d.text: The spirit of strength does not always refer to physical strength. To face adversity both from within and without is what it means to take my shape.

255940|9cc50b7d.name: Donaal Downbreeze
255940|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

256076|f046599c.name: Damaged Construct
256076|f046599c.text: <A faint whirring sound can be heard coming from underneath the construct's metal armor plates. The wind powering this machine is present but is listless and only faintly churning. You don't need to know much about air constructs to know that this unit is clearly not in good repair.>

256083|6571d699.name: Riaani Nightwind
256083|6571d699.text: <Riaani seems to be intently focused on his work on the wind construct.>

256930|341966bb.name: Captured Bandit
256930|341966bb.text:
Most of my outfit did. Displaced from the ground falling out from under our feet. Some came from other islands entirely. I came from the city of Shen'dramar, on the big island. Well, what used to be the big island, I suppose.

My family and I managed to get on one of the last skycutters out of there before the entire island broke apart. We thought that Zephras would save us. Well, it didn't. They are all long dead and now I'm here, awaiting execution.

256930|70ce7a83.name: Captured Bandit
256930|70ce7a83.text: Desperation? Hunger? I'm not exactly here doing this because I like robbing and murdering. I lost my home, had nowhere to go, and I don't much care to shave my head and worship some imaginary wind god, so I became a bandit. The rest is obvious.

256930|b893349b.name: Captured Bandit
256930|b893349b.text: Largely, yes. The thing we all have in common is that we have nowhere else to go and that we prefer thieving over enslaving ourselves to some insane cult.

256930|d07034d1.name: Captured Bandit
256930|d07034d1.text: Killed a peacekeeper and stole some windstones.

256930|dc9d79f6.name: Captured Bandit
256930|dc9d79f6.text: Why bother denying it, the constable already passed her judgement. No point lying.

257003|ec1a6e0b.name: Ishlee Breezewhisper
257003|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257004|d62b45b0.name: Eaysaa Brightgust
257004|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257005|1a6886aa.name: Valiena Swiftgale
257005|1a6886aa.text: Ah, hello. You look as though you have a question for me.

257006|8cd6b7fd.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|8cd6b7fd.text: I don't get too many cooks in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257008|d62b45b0.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257008|fb513610.name: Baelann Swiftcurrent
257008|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

257018|2957a3a0.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

257018|c65683ed.name: Naleeia Tattermend
257018|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257019|fb513610.name: Nyassa Swiftdraught
257019|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

257020|c65683ed.name: Nasalanna Windsinger
257020|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257020|d62b45b0.name: Nasalanna Windsinger
257020|d62b45b0.text: Gales greetings, friend. Is there something I can help you with?

257020|fb513610.name: Nasalanna Windsinger
257020|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

257024|ec1a6e0b.name: Mendalass Tattermend
257024|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257036|a6bb08a8.name: Baelann Favorbreeze
257036|a6bb08a8.text: Welcome to the Bank of Valanaar. We can secure your belongings and valuables here should you so desire. Do you wish to access your deposit box?

257065|819f44a1.name: Missionary Jasaan
257065|819f44a1.text: Do you seek the blessings of the Windlord?

257554|41088e5c.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
257554|41088e5c.text: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>

257944|37940c1f.name: Elegael Thornpaw
257944|37940c1f.text: I cannot believe we were taken by surprise by the Al'Aketh. They have never been hostile to us before, but with their ambush they injured many of my kin. I swear I will get revenge for the fallen and wounded druids of my den. Mark my words, they will pay.

259012|517aef13.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
259012|517aef13.text: All of the $r islands became destabilized and began to move apart a few years ago. If that wasn't bad enough, now large pieces of Zephras are beginning to fall away. It's hard to imagine your home falling into the sky, but that is my reality now.

259084|637067e7.name: Denaaris Stargale
259084|637067e7.text: Wind's greetings, friend. I've been authorized to offer fellow $R quick passage to the city of Stormwind. Please feel free to utilize this portal at your leisure.

263113|81449513.name: Myriaal Mistwake
263113|81449513.text: It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.

265756|eefee559.name: Genn Fairweather
265756|eefee559.text:
Welcome to Fairweather Stables! I would love to provide you with one of our fine galestriders, but it seems like you may not yet have enough experience to ride one.

They are temperamental at times and are prone to toss newer riders if not handled correctly. I would be more than happy to provide the training for you once you are a more seasoned adventurer and have enough coin!

270581|e6b98502.name: Fyrenz Vishonar
270581|e6b98502.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

271465|92b9fbbb.name: Falfaan Halfwind
271465|92b9fbbb.text:
Greetings, $c. Are you in need of arms?

I was trained by Antarion of Ban'aethal, using secrets handed down from the ancient master magesmiths of Kalimdor.

You'll find no finer weapons on Zephras Isle than mine.

275269|d9943d35.name: High Order Dockmaster
275269|d9943d35.text: Board here for transport to Dalaran City, nestled in the Alterac Mountains.

275491|0edd6da8.name: Randal Emerson
275491|0edd6da8.text: Greetings, citizen. How may I help you today?

275491|9fd8120c.name: Randal Emerson
275491|9fd8120c.text:
Ah yes, he mentioned that an agent of the High Order would be arriving in Stormwind soon. He asked me to draft instructions for you.

<Randal hands you a neatly sealed note.>

This should give you all the information you need. You are in for quite the journey, $N. I wish you luck on behalf of Stormwind and the Alliance.

2784|970770be.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
2784|970770be.text:
Ah, so you have. You are most welcome in Ironforge, $c. 

This city is the seat of the Bronzebeard Clan. We are an ancient and proud people and our craftsmen are second to none. You'll find no finer creations of metal or stonework than those of dwarven-make.

We are also amongst the boldest of explorers on Azeroth. If you have a taste for adventure, you will be in good company amongst our people.

Thank you for speaking with me, $N. Go now with the blessings of the Bronzebeard Clan. 

I wish you and your people well.

2788|109efbc8.name: Apprentice Kryten
2788|109efbc8.text: Don't mind Skuerto, $N. He doesn't mean to be rude, he's just terribly busy. While we wait for him to finish scouting, why don't we work on something more productive?

2835|c5ceacbe.name: Cedrik Prose
2835|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

4262|60c9b8b6.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|60c9b8b6.text: Though I find the cool grass which covers Teldrassil as good a bed as any, the beds which Saelienne keeps at the Inn in Craftsman's Terrace are quite suitable for those with a taste for luxury.

4262|ce424d00.name: Darnassus Sentinel
4262|ce424d00.text: Of all the wondrous places within Darnassus, which would you have me direct you to?

483|fe52f4ea.name: Elaine Trias
483|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

4974|e9a7b43b.name: Aldwin Laughlin
4974|e9a7b43b.text: Welcome to the Stormwind Guild Registry offices. What can I help you with today?

4981|ed056522.name: Ben Trias
4981|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

5150|c2e96a28.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|c2e96a28.text: The esteemed Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen can train you further.  He can be found in Theramore treating the wounded at the barracks.

5153|48757048.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|48757048.text: Well, aren't you the smarty-pants? Ye know more than I do, I can tell ye that! Don't go getting' a big head, but if ye want to keep learnin', have a chat with Georgio Bolero in Stormwind. They say he knows his tailorin'!

5159|3b48d638.name: Daryl Riknussun
5159|3b48d638.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

5174|71402677.name: Springspindle Fizzlegear
5174|71402677.text: If my calculations are correct, the wheel will soon be obsolete!

5482|3b48d638.name: Stephen Ryback
5482|3b48d638.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5505|e653c173.name: Theridran
5505|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

5595|329c6da9.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|329c6da9.text: A valuable skill First Aid is.  Our resident trainer, Nissa Firestone, can show ye how it's done.  Look for her on the southern side of The Great Forge at the Ironforge Physician.

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

6735|41276936.name: Innkeeper Saelienne
6735|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6826|f676e73a.name: Talvash del Kissel
6826|f676e73a.text: Um, hello!  If you are here about fee collection and/or a summons, then you must have me mistaken for someone else.  Terribly sorry!

68|37e215b2.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

68|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

68|b925247f.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|b925247f.text: A child of nature are we? Then you need look no further then the moonwell in the Park.

7944|9a62fac1.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
7944|9a62fac1.text:
I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!

Also, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...

170-accept.name: Balir Frosthammer
170-accept.text:
I hope you're here to lend us a hand, $c. After the last trogg attack, we could use all the help we can get.

I hear the buggers have been popping up all across the lands, and it seems Coldridge Valley is no exception. They've been spotted all over the hills to the southeast and near the frozen lake.

And that's not all, just a few nights ago, they attacked and overran our camp to the west! 

We're a bit shorthanded here, lass, and we need strong arms to help drive the troggs back.
170-accept.title: A New Threat

179-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-accept.text:
What do we have here? You look as though you might need something to keep your hands warm, hm?

I'll tell you what would help: a pair of nice, warm gloves. And, being the kind soul that I am, I'd be more than happy to provide you with a suitable pair. I've one condition, however.

I need you to go get me some wolf meat. Nice arrangement, hm? You bring me some wolf meat, and I'll make sure you don't lose any digits to frostbite. Well, what do you say?
179-accept.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-complete.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-complete.text: Ah! Wonderful. The wolf meat should do nicely. Oh, don't worry, $N, I wouldn't forget my part of the bargain. Here, one of these should fit you.
179-complete.title: Dwarven Outfitters

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

2160-accept.name: Hands Springsprocket
2160-accept.text:
Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?

You were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.

Anyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!
2160-accept.title: Supplies to Tannok

233-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
233-accept.text:
Hm, I don't suppose you'd be willing to do a favor for me, lass? A stack of letters came through the pass today, but I don't have the time to send them along.

They're all addressed to Talin Keeneye. You can find him to the west down the road. He's set up camp next to the frozen lake.

What do you say?
233-accept.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

681-accept.name: Captain Nials
681-accept.text:
We are fighting a war for Stromgarde, and we are losing.  The ogres, the Syndicate and we have divided our once great city, and each faction battles the other into a bloody stalemate.

But our forces dwindle while our enemy grows.

We need help from the town of Southshore, but supplies are difficult to receive while the Syndicate holds territory between us.

Go to the Syndicate base in Northfold Manor and slay them.  Then, perhaps, pressure on our supply trains will lessen and more will get through.
681-accept.title: Northfold Manor

684-accept.name: Unknown
684-accept.text:
A bounty has been placed on the head of Marez Cowl, a high-level advisor and operative of the Syndicate.  She was last seen within the Syndicate controlled territory of Stromgarde.

Bounty may be collected from Captain Nials.

Be warned: Marez is a skilled and cunning Warlock, known for her trafficking with demons.  Extreme caution is advised when hunting her.
684-accept.title: WANTED: Marez Cowl

685-accept.name: Unknown
685-accept.text:
The Stromgarde Militia has placed bounties on the heads of Lord Falconcrest, and his bodyguard Otto.  Falconcrest heads the Syndicate's efforts in the Arathi Highlands, and his death would cause a major disruption in those efforts.

His bodyguard Otto, although not a strategic target, is a fierce opponent and has killed dozens of our defenders.

Their bounties may be collected from Captain Nials.
685-accept.title: WANTED: Otto and Falconcrest

691-accept.name: Apprentice Kryten
691-accept.text:
Archmage Malin sent Skuerto and I here to collect reagents for him. I was at a loss as to how I was going to collect the items, but now that you're here, I think my problem's solved.

I need the following: Witherbark tusks, Witherbark medicine pouches and a shadow hunter knife.

Could you find those for me? The Witherbark live to the southeast of Arathi.
691-accept.title: Worth Its Weight in Gold

8311-accept.name: Jesper
8311-accept.text:
I want to go trick-or-treating, but I can't because I'm sick.  If you go for me, I'd trade you the candy you get for some I already have!  I think you'd like this candy - it makes you turn into things both funny and scary!

Each of the innkeepers in the big cities have candy they give for Hallow's End - talk to them and do the tricks they ask for!  Also, a little gnome named Talvash in Ironforge is handing out candy as well.  When you have all the candy, bring them back to me here!
8311-accept.title: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!

8311-complete.name: Jesper
8311-complete.text:
Wow, you got them all!  You're awesome!

Thank you for trick-or-treating for me.  Here, take these pumpkin treats - I think you'll like them a lot!

Happy Hallow's End, $N!
8311-complete.title: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!

8311-progress.name: Jesper
8311-progress.text: Have you finished trick-or-treating yet?  I'm sad that I can't go because I'm sick, but you helping me out makes me feel a little better...
8311-progress.title: Hallow's End Treats for Jesper!

8353-accept.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
8353-accept.text:
Ah, trick-or-treating for a sick child, are we?  I was going to say, you're a little old to be rummaging about for candies...

Well, for my treat - an Ironforge Mint - you will need to... cluck like a chicken!  Yes, chickens love mints... well OK, maybe they don't LOVE them... but I won't give you a mint unless you chicken cluck for me!

Well $c, are you up to the challenge or not?!  Time to earn your treat!
8353-accept.title: Chicken Clucking for a Mint

8353-complete.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
8353-complete.text:
Too funny!  Well done, $N!  Here's your treat.

Happy Hallow's End!
8353-complete.title: Chicken Clucking for a Mint

8355-accept.name: Talvash del Kissel
8355-accept.text:
A trick-or-treater!  Huzzah!

Well now, even though you're doing something noble and collecting candies for a sick child, I can't let you off the hook that easily.  I have a yummy Gnomeregan Gumdrop to give to the sick child... if you make a train noise for me!  Haha, yes, that'll be the trick!  The price of this gumdrop is one train noise!

Chugga-chugga, $c!
8355-accept.title: Incoming Gumdrop

8355-complete.name: Talvash del Kissel
8355-complete.text:
Woo-woo!  Well done, $N!  Here's your treat.

Happy Hallow's End!
8355-complete.title: Incoming Gumdrop

8356-accept.name: Innkeeper Allison
8356-accept.text:
That's an... interesting costume you have on.  Even though you're being nice and helping a sick child trick-or-treat this year, I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you perform a trick for me!

Let's see... you look so strong and buff in that... costume... let's see you flex!  Yes, go on now and flex for me, strong man!

When and only when you flex, I'll give you some tasty Stormwind Nougat.  It's a great Hallow's End treat.
8356-accept.title: Flexing for Nougat

8356-complete.name: Innkeeper Allison
8356-complete.text:
You are truly mighty, haha!  Well done, and thanks for being such a good sport.  Here's your candy.

Happy Hallow's End, $N!
8356-complete.title: Flexing for Nougat

8357-accept.name: Innkeeper Saelienne
8357-accept.text:
Even though you're trick-or-treating for a sick child, you still need to perform a trick for the treat!  We can't very well change the tradition, now can we...

I believe the cost of a piece of marzipan nowadays is to bust out and DANCE!  That's right, let me see your moves!  Dance for me, and I'll give you some tasty marzipan!
8357-accept.title: Dancing for Marzipan

8357-complete.name: Innkeeper Saelienne
8357-complete.text:
You're quite the dancing machine, $N!

Here's your treat for being such a good sport.  Happy Hallow's End, and give my best to your sick little friend!  I hope they get better soon.
8357-complete.title: Dancing for Marzipan

92460-accept.name: Ailee Farheart
92460-accept.text:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92460-accept.title: Coming of Age

92460-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92460-complete.text:
Gale's greetings, $N. I am honored to bestow your coming of age relic today as you are recognized for the potential you bring to the shen'dorei. Our people have faced great hardship and persecution in our complex history.

Today you are given this relic which is one of many held by those before you. Someday when your ashes are scattered to the winds it will pass to another to continue our tradition.

As you take this relic with you know that the winds of home will be with you wherever you travel.
92460-complete.title: Coming of Age

92461-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92461-accept.text:
We live in times of great uncertainty for our people. We face unprecedented challenges that may require bold solutions, but we also must contend with the ordinary and mundane here in Thendal Grove. Take, for example, the recent unsustainable rise in the vuldren population.

The vuldren are a vital part of our ecosystem. However, imbalances must be corrected to maintain the delicate harmony that all creatures in Thendal Grove share.

Head east and cull some of the vuldren there.
92461-accept.title: Harmony in Balance

92461-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92461-complete.text:
Thank you for your service to Zephras, young $c.

The vuldren are typically quite docile, but the animals that call Zephras home can sense when the magic on the winds is out of balance, which can lead to dangerous and unpredictable behavior if left unchecked.
92461-complete.title: Harmony in Balance

92462-accept.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92462-accept.text:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462-accept.title: Infestation Investigation

92462-complete.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92462-complete.text: Judging by the amount of bug entrails covering you, this must be quite the infestation.
92462-complete.title: Infestation Investigation

92463-accept.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92463-accept.text:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
92463-accept.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92463-complete.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92463-complete.text: Excellent work, $N. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.
92463-complete.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92464-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92464-accept.text:
Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.

Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them. 

My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
92464-accept.title: Elemental Unrest

92464-complete.name: Yala Windwatcher
92464-complete.text: Rorian sent you? Good. I could use your aid.
92464-complete.title: Elemental Unrest

92465-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, $c?
92465-accept.title: Agitators

92465-complete.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-complete.text: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.
92465-complete.title: Agitators

92469-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92469-accept.text:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469-accept.title: Return to Rorian

92469-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92469-complete.text:
This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.

You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, $N. Thank you.
92469-complete.title: Return to Rorian

92470-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-accept.text:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470-accept.title: Foul Matriarch

92470-complete.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-complete.text: Very well done. You've felled beasts and laid low cultist interlopers. You have shown great promise but your path must soon take you beyond the relative safety of Thendal Village.
92470-complete.title: Foul Matriarch

92470-progress.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-progress.text: What I ask of you is not easy, but you must be prepared for much greater challenges if you are to survive long enough to be of service to Zephras Isle.
92470-progress.title: Foul Matriarch

92471-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92471-accept.text:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
92471-accept.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92471-complete.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92471-complete.text:
Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.

So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?
92471-complete.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92472-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92472-accept.text:
One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day.

Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
92472-accept.title: The Next Step

92472-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92472-complete.text: Aetheen sent you, then? I'll confess, you don't look like much to me, but Shen'dar Village won't turn down willing aid, much less aid sent from Elder Aetheen herself.
92472-complete.title: The Next Step

92473-accept.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-accept.text:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473-accept.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92473-complete.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-complete.text: Well done, $c. The Rangers of the Grove are in your debt.
92473-complete.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92473-progress.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-progress.text: The ursera have grown far more aggressive of late. I wonder what has changed to cause this shift in behavior?
92473-progress.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92474-accept.name: Myriaal Mistwake
92474-accept.text:
Well hello there, $N! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
92474-accept.title: Falling With Style

92474-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92474-complete.text:
How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our $r gifts!

That being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable.

In the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it.
92474-complete.title: Falling With Style

92474-progress.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92474-progress.text: Using your ability to walk on air can get you out of--and, well... into--all kinds of trouble!
92474-progress.title: Falling With Style

92485-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92485-accept.text:
While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Xyton Silverwind--left this note for you. Read it as soon as you can, and then seek out Silverwind on the ground floor of this great tree just behind me.

Heed his words and his counsel, he can teach you much.
92485-accept.title: A Student of Nature

92485-complete.name: Xyton Silverwind
92485-complete.text:
The flora and fauna of Zephras Isle represent a rich tapestry of vibrant life. The ecosystem requires constant balance to maintain the harmony of nature, and we druids are the keepers of that balance. I see much potential in you, but this path is not an easy one, and you will need guidance as you grow in strength as a student of the fang, the claw, the feather, and the branch. 

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
92485-complete.title: A Student of Nature

92485-progress.name: Xyton Silverwind
92485-progress.text: Greetings, I am Xyton Silverwind, keeper of druidic lore.
92485-progress.title: A Student of Nature

92515-accept.name: Indari Sunseam
92515-accept.text:
As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs.

Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
92515-accept.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92515-complete.name: Indari Sunseam
92515-complete.text: I didn't say it wouldn't be a dirty job, did I?
92515-complete.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92515-progress.name: Indari Sunseam
92515-progress.text: If you ask me, I think Prideclaws are actually kind of cute. From a safe distance... and while standing behind someone holding a sword, of course.
92515-progress.title: The Problem With Prideclaws

92516-accept.name: Teeri Wellwind
92516-accept.text: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.
92516-accept.title: Hippogryph Harassment

92516-complete.name: Teeri Wellwind
92516-complete.text: Well done, and quickly too. Not too bad at all.
92516-complete.title: Hippogryph Harassment

92517-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92517-accept.text:
There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately.

I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
92517-accept.title: The Criminal Element

92517-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92517-complete.text:
With the bandits dispersed, that is one less problem for us to deal with. Though I confess that now I worry that any bandits who survived may turn next to the cult for protection, further bolstering their increasingly alarming numbers.

Still though, we'll take the victories where we can get them.
92517-complete.title: The Criminal Element

92528-accept.name: Missionary Jasaan
92528-accept.text:
The faithful of Al'Akir grow ever stronger with each eager new recruit like yourself. As you can see, our strength gives form to the storm itself!

Normally I'd send you straight to Skypriest Aanders for assessment, but he is occupied at present receiving a guest at the inn on the north side of town. Please avoid that place for now. An unshaven recruit like yourself in the presence of such a guest would be inappropriate.

For now, just don't get in anyone's way.
92528-accept.title: Among the Faithful

92528-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92528-complete.text:
Lorthuna herself was there? She's the leader of the whole damned cult!

If they are making a move on Shen'dar Village and the western watchtower, we've got to be ready. What is strange is... why the watchtower?

The Village I can understand, but the tower? It doesn't have much strategic significance, other than as a minor lookout post.

Regardless, we will be prepared for them. They'll find that highlanders aren't as easy to catch flat footed as they might think.
92528-complete.title: Among the Faithful

92529-accept.name: Sania Silverstream
92529-accept.text:
It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.
92529-accept.title: Falaath Village

92529-complete.name: Missionary Jasaan
92529-complete.text:
What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!

We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.
92529-complete.title: Falaath Village

92544-accept.name: Hanaa Nightwind
92544-accept.text:
A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult.

I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
92544-accept.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92544-complete.name: Hanaa Nightwind
92544-complete.text:
It was all I could do to stop myself from going over and joining you from my position here. I can only hope that these louts got the message and clear out of here soon. 

Thank you, $c. You have the gratitude of the Rangers of Thendal Grove.
92544-complete.title: Al'Aketh Thugs

92550-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92550-accept.text:
Our best defense here might just be a strong offense. The advantage we now have is that we expect an attack is coming. What they won't expect is for us to hit them first.

I've already asked a lot of you, but please head back over to Falaath Village. Kill as many cultists as you can and if you can get close enough, kill the commander and bring me his head. I'll stay here and organize the citizens and our few peacekeepers to prepare a defense... just in case you don't return.
92550-accept.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92550-complete.name: Constable Aonda
92550-complete.text:
Thank the winds you've returned!

Sania Silverstream snuck out of town just before you returned, no doubt fleeing at the sight of our people arming themselves.

You've done an incredible thing for the people of Shen'dar Village and we owe you a debt of gratitude. If the cult returns to the highlands, they will find that Shen'dar is not such an easy target.

Winds guide you, $N.
92550-complete.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92550-progress.name: Constable Aonda
92550-progress.text: It feels good to turn the tables on these zealots.
92550-progress.title: Havoc in the Highlands

92551-accept.name: Danarii Bellowveil
92551-accept.text:
I overheard you might be going to Falaath Village? While you are there, please keep an eye out for our stolen supply caches.

The Al'Aketh have been raiding our supply caravans carrying various goods such as food and windstones to and from the lowlands for months. They've been blaming the bandits, of course, but we all know that it all ends up in the same place. If there's any of that stuff left in Falaath, it would be a huge help if you could recover it.
92551-accept.title: Stolen Supplies

92551-complete.name: Danarii Bellowveil
92551-complete.text: This is great! We've been barely squeaking by without our regular supply deliveries. I'll work with the constable to ensure that these supplies get redistributed to the townsfolk who are in most dire need.
92551-complete.title: Stolen Supplies

92551-progress.name: Danarii Bellowveil
92551-progress.text: There's a lot of hungry and desperate $r here who need these supplies.
92551-progress.title: Stolen Supplies

92553-accept.name: Zerril Softbreeze
92553-accept.text:
Up for a bit of work? I could use a bit of muscle from a strong adventuring-type such as yourself. With how dangerous things are getting around here, no one's had much time to hunt or forage of late, and I need someone to get out there and source me fresh eggs and strider meat to keep this village fed.

I'd be happy to teach you one of my famous recipes if you can bring me what I need. What do you say?
92553-accept.title: Restocking the Larders

92553-complete.name: Zerril Softbreeze
92553-complete.text:
These eggs aren't easy to get but wind save me, they are DELICIOUS fried up in a bit of ursera tallow.

If you've got a bit of time to spare and you enjoy cooking, I can teach you a few tips and tricks I've picked up. Say the word and I'd be happy to train you.
92553-complete.title: Restocking the Larders

92553-progress.name: Zerril Softbreeze
92553-progress.text: No matter how much things change here on Zephras and how uncertain things get, I always say that a pipe full of dried peacebloom and nice full belly is a comfort that can't be beat!
92553-progress.title: Restocking the Larders

92596-accept.name: Rathiril Sunlance
92596-accept.text:
The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting.

Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
92596-accept.title: The High Order

92596-complete.name: Rathiril Sunlance
92596-complete.text:
The High Order's mission is vital to the survival of our people. We hold our elemental benefactors in the utmost regard, but we must face reality; they are gone now, and we are on our own.

Between threats from within such as the Al'Aketh, and uncertainties of our security on this plane, it is our destiny as Highborne descendants of our ancestral home of Eldre'Thalas to use our gifts to ensure that the shen'dorei can stand on our own once again.
92596-complete.title: The High Order

92597-accept.name: Falorne Fallwind
92597-accept.text:
Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from leylines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these leylines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.

Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a leyline there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.
92597-accept.title: Reading the Leylines

92597-complete.name: Falorne Fallwind
92597-complete.text:
Do you feel it? Yes? Good! You have taken your first steps. You'll find that with your abilities, you will be able to tap into latent magical energy in many locations. Doing so will provide a myriad of benefits, some profound, others more subtle. You won't know until you tap into them, but that's the best part of the gift... making the unknown known.

If we are to survive these dire times, we must be unwavering in our search for knowledge... and power.
92597-complete.title: Reading the Leylines

92679-accept.name: Alvarion Windfield
92679-accept.text:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The $R man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679-accept.title: Blood Tithe

92679-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92679-complete.text:
<Aamelia listens while you explain what became of Alvarion.>

At least I know he's going to be safe in Valanaar.

Stranger, I hate to tell you this but I think my idiot husband likely just sent you here to die for nothing. If you have any sense at all, you should leave now. This isn't your fight.
92679-complete.title: Blood Tithe

92682-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-accept.text:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.
92682-accept.title: Make Yourself Useful

92682-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-complete.text: I watched you take down those bandits from the window. Not bad.
92682-complete.title: Make Yourself Useful

92682-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-progress.text: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.
92682-progress.title: Make Yourself Useful

92683-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-accept.text:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.
92683-accept.title: Flutterfly Dust

92683-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-complete.text:
This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.

Don't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.
92683-complete.title: Flutterfly Dust

92683-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-progress.text: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.
92683-progress.title: Flutterfly Dust

92684-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-accept.text:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.
92684-accept.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92684-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-complete.text: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.
92684-complete.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92684-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-progress.text: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... well, too long.
92684-progress.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92685-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-accept.text:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
92685-accept.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92685-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-complete.text:
When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.

On a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.

Ferauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?
92685-complete.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92685-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-progress.text:
If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.

<Aamelia laughs loudly.>
92685-progress.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92693-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-accept.text:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.
92693-accept.title: Standing Our Ground

92693-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-complete.text: I... can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.
92693-complete.title: Standing Our Ground

92698-accept.name: Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct
92698-accept.text:
<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>
92698-accept.title: What Is My Purpose?

92698-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92698-complete.text:
The construct? It's been wandering around the fields for decades. Since the wind elementals left us, I think. Alvarion suspected that it used to haul harvests to market, or maybe tend to livestock back before this was an orchard. That could have been a thousand years ago though.

In the old days, the Windshapers used to maintain these constructs. We've talked about petitioning them to come and take a look at it, but it's never been a pressing concern to us. Mostly we just ignore it these days.
92698-complete.title: What Is My Purpose?

92699-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92699-accept.text:
Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the High Order here. The current Supreme Magister, Elaadrin Evengale and his people operate out of the lodge on the far southeastern part of Valanaar.

You should also take care, the High Order and Windshapers don't get along very well here. Be careful and give the Windshapers a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
92699-accept.title: The Supreme Magister

92699-complete.name: Elaadrin Evengale
92699-complete.text:
Hello and welcome. Rathiril sent me a magical missive about you and he mentioned you had some promise.

With you standing before me now, I can see why he suggested you seek me out. You have a vibrant arcane aura about you. Few enough of us anymore have the aptitude, let alone the will, to do what is needed to save our home. Do you have the boldness and strength needed to aid the High Order?

I suppose we will see.
92699-complete.title: The Supreme Magister

92701-accept.name: Constable Aonda
92701-accept.text:
For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here.
